content: Have you ever witnessed any crimes or accidents?
I don't quite remember. Why did you ask that?
I was taking a walk in the park early this morning when suddenly I heard someone calling 'help'. I rushed over and saw a man beating a woman.
Oh, my. What did you do?
I guess I was stunned for a moment, then I quickly ran away to get help.
Yes. Fortunately, I had my cell with me this morning. I called the police as I was running to get people to come to help.
